language.reason: Bundled Lingua CPU language detector; original XLM-R language pack remains optional.

extractions.reason: Typed-field extraction is turned off (--extraction-model none); clover_extract_json uses the generalist LLM.

transcribe.reason: OpenRouter transcription. Public audio URL, base64 or audio data URI; no translation or word timestamps.

web_scrape.reason: Bundled Clover Web static HTML/document extraction; no browser or inference key.

extract.reason: Install builtin/clover-gliner with Warren, then configure --gliner-worker. Pinned GLiNER medium with CPU wheels, exact spans and the Clover extraction contract; a model change from legacy large.

nli3.reason: Requires a compatible three-way NLI worker. Hosted Decisions adapters are opt-in because the legacy contradiction tests differ. No validated Warren pack for this exact contract yet.

ocr.reason: Requires a compatible Granite-Docling worker; plain vision prose does not implement the document contract. Warren pack not yet shipped.

document_parse.reason: Requires a compatible Granite-Docling worker with blocks, tables and source geometry. Warren pack not yet shipped.

forecast.reason: Requires compatible Chronos-2 quantile forecasts. The seasonal-trend-baseline Warren pack is a different algorithm/contract, not a replacement.

timeseries_anomalies.reason: Install builtin/clover-tspulse with Warren, then configure --tspulse-worker. Pinned CPU checkpoints preserve Zoo v2 semantics; 1536 points for anomalies, 512 for other operations. Time-series vectors are separate from text embeddings.

timeseries_impute.reason: Install builtin/clover-tspulse with Warren, then configure --tspulse-worker. Pinned CPU checkpoints preserve Zoo v2 semantics; 1536 points for anomalies, 512 for other operations. Time-series vectors are separate from text embeddings.

timeseries_embed.reason: Install builtin/clover-tspulse with Warren, then configure --tspulse-worker. Pinned CPU checkpoints preserve Zoo v2 semantics; 1536 points for anomalies, 512 for other operations. Time-series vectors are separate from text embeddings.

timeseries_similarity.reason: Install builtin/clover-tspulse with Warren, then configure --tspulse-worker. Pinned CPU checkpoints preserve Zoo v2 semantics; 1536 points for anomalies, 512 for other operations. Time-series vectors are separate from text embeddings.

image_embed.reason: Requires compatible SigLIP2 worker. Image vectors are a separate space, not Voyage text embeddings. Warren pack not yet shipped.

tabular_fit.reason: Requires real TabPFN fit/blob contract. tabular/tabpfn-foundation is a reference implementation and cannot replace it. Compatible Warren pack not yet shipped.

tabular_predict.reason: Requires real TabPFN predict/blob contract, paired with the fit worker. Compatible Warren pack not yet shipped.

tabular_explain.reason: Requires compatible fitted-model SHAP worker, including anomaly artifacts. The existing CPU analytics pack does not yet implement this route.

relations.reason: Requires compatible REBEL relation triples. Warren pack not yet shipped.

web_research.reason: CPU + OpenRouter/Exa + Clover Web. Run scripts/clover/research.py for Postgres evidence storage, configure.py --research, and start the research Compose profile. No GPU or SQLite.

computer_decide.reason: Optional Qwen3.5-4B + Cua-S1 scorer. The desktop works without it: Jev is the default chooser and Callie can use the desktop directly. Run this scorer on a local GPU or a compatible remote service. Compose package available; Warren installer not yet shipped.

cluster.reason: Install builtin/clover-analytics with Warren and configure --analytics-worker.

anomaly_fit.reason: Install builtin/clover-analytics with Warren and configure --analytics-worker.

anomaly_score.reason: Install builtin/clover-analytics with Warren and configure --analytics-worker.
